question: Should SENSEAUDIO_API_KEY, previously used for bundled transcription, automatically select SenseAudio for unpinned web search after an upgrade?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility and provider-routing policy choice, not a purely mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Require explicit web-search opt-in
options.body: Support SenseAudio search when users select the provider or configure its scoped web-search credential, preserving existing unpinned routing.

options.title: Accept automatic selection
options.body: Permit the existing environment credential to select SenseAudio search and explicitly own the resulting upgrade behavior in documentation and tests.

recommendation.title: Require explicit web-search opt-in
recommendation.body: Support SenseAudio search when users select the provider or configure its scoped web-search credential, preserving existing unpinned routing.
